98cc7isafx.en: Yes yes, before four. Come on.

29x3ui8rsu3.en: Here. Careful. You ask for everything.

136r19lhhyp.en: No, son. The nearest town is very far.

1disqg2wje9.hi: Haan uncle. Bike ke plug se.

185h6m5p0yu.en: No reason. Will you have tea?

1exyy2h1u22.hi: Phone toh kisi ke paas nahi hai abhi.
1exyy2h1u22.en: Nobody has a phone available right now.

1fxy7on4a4x.hi: Itni raat ko jungle ka raasta theek nahi hai. Subah chale jaana.

bltkhqseoo.hi: Aaj raat yahin ruk jao. Subah main khud chhod dunga.

1u1gxttdkao.hi: Nahi uncle, please. Abhi jaana zaroori hai.
1u1gxttdkao.en: No uncle, please. We have to go now.

iw6m8frshy.hi: Bheeg ke aaye hain, thand lagi hogi. Chalna padega.

22eb0s47ikd.hi: Beta, tum aaj ek galti kar rahe ho.

1dj28is3d90.hi: Uncle aur unke dost... itni raat ko hamare liye nikle. Shukriya.
1dj28is3d90.en: The uncle and his friends... coming out at this hour for us. Thank you.

ovqo9o8q0q.en: (whisper) Do not say it. Keep walking.

ev6vfwe843.hi: Raasta... patla hota ja raha hai.

57omx6rlyi.hi: Mujhe nahi lagta road is taraf hogi. Par aur kya karein.

kk3sgw0067.en: Uncle, where did those two go?

204a2n97khh.hi: Par abhi toh saath hi chal rahe the.
204a2n97khh.en: But they were walking with us just now.

1blomfd5hc4.en: From behind the bush... a whisper.

1pigbv7403k.hi: Chala gaya. Bas ek lakeer jaisa.

izhyxofgzd.hi: Kadam... do se zyada logon ke.

1k0mcthevhp.en: (you turn. Nishant is far off, photographing a rock)

25bu0ftjral.en: What was that? A man? An animal?

2ctvzo2q7z9.hi: Ye toh... shamshan hai. Mukti Dham.
2ctvzo2q7z9.en: This is... a cremation ground. Mukti Dham.

1m72k5dc9po.en: Go straight that way. Straight on.

14p2it4tvxp.hi: Gayab. Koi aawaz nahi. Koi parchhai nahi.

bym452pw9e.hi: Scooter ka tyre... puncture ho gaya.

zjnls5zr4d.hi: Lekin hum ek ghar mein gaye the. Ek uncle the...
zjnls5zr4d.en: But we went into a house. There was an uncle...

rqnxrxqozq.hi: Ek baat... us uncle ne humein jo pilaya tha, woh kya tha?

hzz5fbg9y1.hi: Nahi. Kuch bhi clear yaad nahi.
hzz5fbg9y1.en: No. I can't clearly remember anything.

12o191lqf7z.en: (under his breath) Nishant... come back soon...

14nhn2iraxf.hi: Pata nahi. Bahut der se ek hi jagah maar raha hai.
14nhn2iraxf.en: No idea. He's been hitting one spot for ages.

27xjw6z0g2p.hi: Aur usko thakaan bhi nahi ho rahi.

2dg68qz48zk.hi: Kya hum phir kisi loop mein phans gaye?
2dg68qz48zk.en: Have we got stuck in another loop?

1g49eggiqh1.hi: Par ye shamshan hai. Yahan toh aisa nahi hona chahiye...
1g49eggiqh1.en: But this is a cremation ground. This shouldn't happen here...

1aqtjdip92i.hi: Chal, usse poochhte hain. Shayad usse raasta pata ho.
1aqtjdip92i.en: Come on, let's ask him. Maybe he knows the way.

ck3bbnyhpu.hi: Yaar mat ja... mujhe theek nahi lag raha.
ck3bbnyhpu.en: Don't, man... this doesn't feel right.

1be1knjmg0j.hi: (fusfusakar) Agar mudein toh wo nazar se hat jaayega.
1be1knjmg0j.en: (whispering) If we turn, we might lose sight of him.

1iwozz06tc6.hi: Yahan kisi ko hamare naam nahi pata.

22w03qsnh4w.hi: Insaan jaisa lag raha hai... par...
22w03qsnh4w.en: He sounds like a person... but...

1qa4y2vyry5.hi: Toh insaan hi hoga. Mudte hain.
1qa4y2vyry5.en: Then it must be a person. Let's turn.

1sqxz87a9hl.hi: Hum jungle mein bhatak gaye the... raat bhar.
1sqxz87a9hl.en: We got lost in the forest... all night.

hq8k05rnqj.hi: Nahi. Haan, uth sakte hain. Bas chheel gaya hai. Mere dost ko bukhaar lag raha hai.
hq8k05rnqj.en: No. Yes, we can stand. Just scrapes. My friend feels feverish.

yerey6i7wl.hi: (aap dono ne poori raat ki kahani sunayi...)
yerey6i7wl.en: (You both tell him everything, piece by piece...)

1ewyel419kl.hi: Network aa gaya! Ghar pe phone kar.

25hzrj7ihsj.hi: Mummy, hum theek hain. Bas aa rahe hain. Aake sab batayenge.
25hzrj7ihsj.en: Mom, we're fine. We're on our way. We'll explain everything when we arrive.

1kvn06t70ub.hi: Us uncle ne humein kuch pilaya tha na?
1kvn06t70ub.en: That uncle gave us something to drink, didn't he?

1dori04xu3h.hi: Haan... laal sa tha. Sharbat jaisa.
1dori04xu3h.en: Yes... it was reddish. Like sharbat.

13obrdhcdtj.en: Did we tell that man (the stranger) this?

1enfecgqlqp.en: And that stranger never asked whether we'd had anything to drink.

1ysvw6fmc8f.en: There was a man... he ran after us...

1u2tjpdkzkb.en: I only remember running. No face.

r7cjf1dwjk.hi: Mummy... hum shaam tak aana chahte the.
r7cjf1dwjk.en: Mom... we meant to be back by evening.

rb4dz6wlsa.en: These are my friends. Bhola and Mangu.

1mg0zow4s10.en: Hey kids, namaste! Come on, it is late.

3k86gld2db.en: (something like your name, from the dark)

t14wnaotri.en: Where were you two? Do you know how worried we were?

1ku32yzcjau.hi: Beta! Dono ko dekho... ye kya haal bana rakha hai!
1ku32yzcjau.en: Look at you both! What state are you in!

1n31p3d014r.hi: Tumhara tiffin toh ghar pe hi pada tha.
1n31p3d014r.en: Your tiffin was left right here at home.

gcxyyegtoq.en: There is no village that way. The place you describe is just a cremation ground.

1kapo9qafso.en: Brother... I've lost my way. Do you two know the way?

3ly87sszmb.hi: Utho bhai... utho. Paani chhidak raha hoon. Aankhein kholo.
3ly87sszmb.en: Get up, brother... wake up. I'm sprinkling water. Open your eyes.

aq6ma4nk6b.hi: Pehle ye batao - kahan se aaye ho? Shamshan mein raat ko kya kar rahe the?
aq6ma4nk6b.en: First tell me - where have you come from? What were you doing in the cremation ground at night?

27pd08tlgg9.hi: Kisi samadhi ko haath toh nahi lagaya? Chot toh nahi lagi? Khade ho sakte ho?
27pd08tlgg9.en: You didn't touch any samadhi? Are you hurt? Can you stand?

12r9ihxrkux.hi: Haan, tap hai thoda. Cheelein bhi hain. Ab batao, poori raat ki baat, ek-ek karke.
12r9ihxrkux.en: Yes, a little fever. Scratches too. Now tell me the whole night, one thing at a time.

1cpr3e09qvo.hi: Raat, baarish, thakaan aur andhera milkar cheezon ko waise dikhate hain jaise woh hoti nahi hain. Tum dono bahut der se bhatak rahe the.
1cpr3e09qvo.en: Night, rain, tiredness and darkness together show you things as they are not. You two were wandering a long time.

26yjme70qtg.hi: Chal sakte ho? Wo kachchi sadak seedhi road tak jaati hai. Subah ho rahi hai. Ghar waalon ko phone kar dena.
26yjme70qtg.en: Can you walk? That dirt track leads straight to the road. It's getting light. Call your families.

zwrn7xayn.hi: Kahan the tum log?! Seedhe ghar aao!
zwrn7xayn.en: Where were you?! Come straight home!

910kqq08fc.hi: Hosh aa gaya. Hilo mat, drip lagi hai.
910kqq08fc.en: He's awake. Don't move, there's a drip in.

hgg47ug9gw.hi: Bagal wale bistar par. Zinda hai, ghabrao mat.
hgg47ug9gw.en: In the next bed. He's alive, don't panic.

15qr92e3xx0.hi: Subah gaon waalon ne tum dono ko khudai ke gadde mein paaya. Scooter bagal mein padi thi. Chot aur sadma, bas.
15qr92e3xx0.en: Villagers found you both this morning in the excavation pit. The scooter was beside you. Injuries and shock, that's all.

raoe7zxcdg.hi: Raat mein ghaaon ke paas koi nahi jaata. Shayad gir gaye ho, ghabra gaye ho. Doctor sahab aayenge.
raoe7zxcdg.en: Nobody goes near that ground at night. Maybe you fell, got scared. The doctor will come.

1juyi6zzim7.hi: Beta! Dono ko dekho... Bhagwan ka shukar hai.
1juyi6zzim7.en: My boys! Thank God, thank God.

20uvfer3a95.en: This is the path. Come on, in we go.

rf7jaucy6b.hi: Bike sal ke neeche lag gayi. Safe hai.
rf7jaucy6b.en: The bike is under the sal tree. It is safe.

rn2atjy1s5.en: Can you hear that? Someone is here.

1lquqxhkh1d.hi: Wahi camp hai. Log bhi hain, bikes bhi.
1lquqxhkh1d.en: That is the camp. People and bikes, both.

t3436z0i3t.hi: (dheere) Stream us taraf jaa rahi hai. Agar kabhi raasta bhoolein, toh paani ke saath chalo.
t3436z0i3t.en: (to himself) The stream flows that way. If we ever lose the path, follow the water.

1gznt6p1d7g.hi: Bhai, tu kab se Bear Grylls ban gaya?
1gznt6p1d7g.en: Since when are you Bear Grylls?

1na92n4rnjp.hi: Bas aise hi, dekh raha hoon.

2f3dg6fqbr1.hi: Main? Tu gaata hai. Ghar ke shower mein jo concert hota hai, uska kya?
2f3dg6fqbr1.en: Me? You sing. What about your shower concerts?

27x7wrv54av.hi: Uncle, agar andhera ho jaye toh kaise bachein?
27x7wrv54av.en: Uncle, how do we stay safe if it gets dark?

1ujp5kjz5ao.hi: Ye kisne banaya? Ek gaon... ek kuan... bargad ka ped.
1ujp5kjz5ao.en: Who drew this? A village... a well... a banyan tree.

7zmj8gldr0.hi: Ek hi biscuit bacha hai. Rock-paper-scissors!

emtvwusxng.hi: Paper rock ko dhak leta hai. Tu jeeta.

2g52pcr69vj.hi: Teen, do, ek, ab! Tu haar gaya!
2g52pcr69vj.en: Three, two, one, now! You lose!

22uw0eesody.hi: Bhai, tu toh rules hi badal deta hai.

cz0xj45ftm.hi: Bhai, ye toh perfect hai. Aise hi ruk jaate hain yahin.
cz0xj45ftm.en: This is perfect. Let's just stay here.

26gpe248v8u.hi: Ki Bear Grylls ne roka tha.

1snigc5rm5j.hi: Haan uncle. Bas aag bujha ke nikalte hain.
1snigc5rm5j.en: Yes, uncle. We will put the fire out and leave.

1sc2zqt51co.en: Yes. Put the fire out. Come on.

1804mbx18q9.hi: Ye achanak kya hua? Baadal kahan se aa gaye?
1804mbx18q9.en: What was that? Where did these clouds come from?

15bb7y85wla.en: (nervous laugh) We went round in a circle.

1gig2b5xavx.hi: Bhai, tu wahan se kyun aaya? Main toh tujhe udhar dekh raha tha!
1gig2b5xavx.en: Why did you come from there? I was watching you the other way!

200cksox145.hi: Maine tujhe wahan jaate dekha tha...
200cksox145.en: I saw you walk off that way...

vlvdouu7te.hi: Tu Bear Grylls ban gaya tha na? Ab bata.
vlvdouu7te.en: You were Bear Grylls, weren't you? Now tell me.

9wdufaqh5t.hi: Nishant. Sun. Ye awaaz aage ja rahi hai. Peeche nahi.
9wdufaqh5t.en: Nishant. Listen. This sound is going ahead. Not behind.

1z4iho55tu6.hi: Matlab... ya toh ye humein bike tak le jayega, ya bike ki jagah le jayega.
1z4iho55tu6.en: Either it leads us to the bike... or to wherever the bike is meant to be.

1zpl1e57g7.hi: Bhai, ye options kaun deta hai?

ioe0ugvqov.hi: Koi nahi. Aur koi doosra option bhi nahi hai.
ioe0ugvqov.en: Nobody. And there is no other option.

106qc146pvz.hi: Camp thoda aage hai. Shaam se pehle wapas aa jaana.
106qc146pvz.en: The camp is just ahead. Get back before evening.

je74r5m997.hi: Pehli kick pe? Aaj pakka kuch hone wala hai.
je74r5m997.en: First kick? Something is definitely going to happen today.

bb1d3jhl2z.hi: Shukar kar aur chal. Entry board tak zyada door nahi hoga.
bb1d3jhl2z.en: Be thankful and ride. The entry board cannot be far.

1m9awgjvxw8.en: The board has not come yet?

1wwk4avst7c.hi: Ye toh wahi fork hai... ye daali pehle nahi thi.
1wwk4avst7c.en: This is the same fork... that branch was not here before.

1fhwyyygk4f.hi: Bhai, wapas chalte hain. Ye theek nahi lag raha.
1fhwyyygk4f.en: Let us go back. This does not feel right.

968i1azhtn.hi: Matlab wapas jaane ka option hi nahi hai?
968i1azhtn.en: So there is no going back?

1l0h8fw3fsq.hi: Speedometer bees kilometre dikha raha hai. Aur awaaz utni hi tez hai.
1l0h8fw3fsq.en: Twenty kilometres an hour. And the footsteps keep exactly the same pace.

k8ardq2d9t.hi: Kuch nahi. Hum bahar nikal jayenge.

1e05jekbap6.hi: Nahi, tank mein hai. Plug geela ho gaya hoga.
1e05jekbap6.en: No, there is petrol. The plug must be wet.

22jera106dt.hi: Is mud mein bike nahi chalegi. Aur hum geele hain.
22jera106dt.en: The bike is not going anywhere in this mud. And we are soaked.

1zvdcnu5bjj.hi: Haan. Mere haath sunn ho rahe hain.
1zvdcnu5bjj.en: Yes. My hands are going numb.

aeg1oo513g.hi: Wo bamboo ka jhund, ooncha hai. Wahan paani nahi rukega.
aeg1oo513g.en: That bamboo grove is on high ground. Water will not stand there.

11lg6n0za8b.hi: Wahi ek jagah hai jo dikh rahi hai. Chal.
11lg6n0za8b.en: It is the only place in sight. Come on.

bjc90uwumw.hi: Bhai, ye bahut bhaari hai. Dhakka lagate hain, dono milkar.
bjc90uwumw.en: This is heavy. Let us push together.

18tdumm5ag4.hi: Bhai, mujhe bahut thand lag rahi hai.

1jtv20vocyz.hi: Bike ka plug. Arunab ne kaha tha chingari deta hai. Aur tank mein petrol hai.
1jtv20vocyz.en: The bike plug. Arunab said it gives a spark. And there is petrol in the tank.

2akfeo8j00p.hi: Petrol door rakhna. Wo bhi bola tha.
2akfeo8j00p.en: Keep petrol far. He said that too.

16iv9wdrib5.hi: (fusfusakar) Haan. Kaam karte raho. Mat ruk. Agar ruk gaye toh darr jaayenge.
16iv9wdrib5.en: (whisper) Yes. Keep working. Do not stop, or we will freeze up with fear.

19ku8reoaiw.hi: Bhai, ye itni dry kaise hai? Kisi ne yahan rakhi hain kya?
19ku8reoaiw.en: How is this so dry? Did someone put it here?

1g0cnl5l32w.en: It is a forest. Pick it up, come on.

svbuiiuv1p.hi: Bhai, bamboo jalne mein tez hota hai. Agar jhund mein aag lag gayi toh?
svbuiiuv1p.en: Bamboo burns fast. What if the grove catches?

1par7yi8m2v.hi: Khule mein. Hawa se aag bujh na jaaye.
1par7yi8m2v.en: In the open. Hope the wind does not kill it.

17vc8kmhue0.hi: Isiliye pathar ka ghera banate hain.
17vc8kmhue0.en: That is why we build a ring of stones.

1urmhzbv03m.hi: (apne aap se) Maine kuch nahi dekha.

1qpofunj3rd.hi: Bas ek dhakkan jitna. Tiffin ka dhakkan. Aur ek kapda chahiye.
1qpofunj3rd.en: Just a capful. The tiffin lid. And a cloth.

1afn39019if.hi: Mera rumaal? Bhai, ye mera favourite hai.
1afn39019if.en: My handkerchief? It is my favourite.

1h0wme1ynw.en: Do you want to save your life or the hankie?

1mr003rcquc.hi: Torch tank se door rakh. Mobile bhi. Koi spark nahi.
1mr003rcquc.en: Keep the torch away from the tank. The phone too. No sparks.

e6m2an9nn8.hi: Haan, mera phone pocket mein hai.
e6m2an9nn8.en: Yes, my phone is in my pocket.

1f17ffz4due.hi: Aur zyada mat daalna. Zyada hoga toh aag bhadkegi. Hamara kaam chhoti aag se hai.
1f17ffz4due.en: Do not pour too much. A big flare is not what we want.

4uhnlpiuoc.hi: Chacha wala plug? Waah. Kamaal ka dimaag hai.

xvqz6dwk6g.hi: Aaj pehli baar tune tareef ki.
xvqz6dwk6g.en: First time you ever praised me.

19mj0o3yfyx.hi: Bike ka apna plug geela hai. Kapde aur garm haath se sukhana padega.
19mj0o3yfyx.en: The bike's own plug is wet. I have to dry it against cloth and warm skin.

1k0iu8dlg26.hi: Bhai... baarish ruk gayi thi na?

1l9eba5gxrv.hi: Bhai! Hum aag jala diye! Hum sach mein aag jala diye!
1l9eba5gxrv.en: We lit a fire! We actually lit a fire!

1f91fq3s8bd.hi: Haan! Plug ka kamaal. Chacha ko bolunga.
1f91fq3s8bd.en: Yes! The plug did it. I will tell Chacha.

ou4sobyut3.hi: Bhai, bachpan mein main andhere se bahut darr jaata tha. Mat bata kisi ko.
ou4sobyut3.en: As a kid I was terrified of the dark. Do not tell anyone.

t5qafw975n.hi: Nahi bataunga. Mujhe paani se darr lagta tha. Talab ke paas jaane se.
t5qafw975n.en: I will not. I was scared of water. Of going near the pond.

4prp869ptc.hi: Haan, yaad hai. Tu ab bhi nahi tairta.
4prp869ptc.en: I remember. You still do not swim.

42zu4441a.hi: Mujhe ghar ki yaad aa rahi hai.

5agxb2gp7m.hi: Mujhe bhi. Mummy chai banati hongi, baar baar phone dekh rahi hongi.
5agxb2gp7m.en: Me too. Mummy is making tea and checking her phone again and again.

g55uupowj4.hi: Karan ka wo gaana yaad hai? Jo uske dimaag mein atka tha?
g55uupowj4.en: Remember Karan's song, the one stuck in his head?

jq2hw6qsg6.hi: Haan... ab mujhe bhi wahi dhun yaad aa rahi hai.
jq2hw6qsg6.en: Yes... now I can remember that tune too.

c2kw4wgpfg.hi: Bhai, aag ke paas koi nahi aa raha.
c2kw4wgpfg.en: Nobody is coming near the fire.

1axhurmt96h.en: Meaning... it is afraid of the fire?

2ergkusil7k.hi: Ya shayad intezaar kar raha hai.

1rkkpvc4nt6.hi: Bhai, hilna mat. Ye mummy nahi hai. Hum unhe bata ke aaye the.
1rkkpvc4nt6.en: Do not move. That is not Mummy. We told her we would be back.

fr5ix8r9r1.hi: Aag peeche kyun ja rahi hai?
fr5ix8r9r1.en: Why is the flame pointing backward?

1nn944ofnoc.hi: Hawa aage se aa rahi hai.
1nn944ofnoc.en: The wind is coming from the front.

25gfzevhrwg.hi: Aag hilti hai. Ye diya hai, ya lantern.
25gfzevhrwg.en: A fire flickers. This is a lamp or a lantern.

105t4um6s6u.hi: Pole bhi nahi hai. Ek tar bhi nahi.
105t4um6s6u.en: No poles. Not a single wire.

1400r6se25m.hi: Aath minute baad... phir gaon aage hai.
1400r6se25m.en: Eight minutes later, the village is ahead again.

npox0edah3.hi: Baayen mude, phir bhi aage. Alag disha se.
npox0edah3.en: We turned left. Still ahead of us. From a new direction.

qs08bl87d2.hi: Do hi raaste hain. Jungle mein ghoomte rahein, ya gaon mein jaayein.
qs08bl87d2.en: There are only two ways. Keep wandering the forest, or go in.

2dk85m3akmp.hi: Kam se kam chhat toh milegi.
2dk85m3akmp.en: At least there will be a roof.

17nofvh8bed.hi: Bhai, aasman aur kaala ho gaya hai. Hum andar hi chalte hain.
17nofvh8bed.en: The sky is even darker. We are going in.

1njvjclm54t.hi: Nishaan... aag se door aaja beta... thand lag jayegi...
1njvjclm54t.en: Nishan... come away from the fire, beta... you will catch a chill...

1bkklnjv3xb.hi: Beta? Tum dono yahan kya kar rahe ho? Itna andhera ho gaya.
1bkklnjv3xb.en: Son? What are you two doing out here? It is so late.

18bu15hd4o7.hi: Chalo, andar chalte hain. Raat baarish se pehle nikalna padega.
18bu15hd4o7.en: Come. Let us go inside. We must be in before the rain.

awaaz_3.en: Brother... I have lost my way.
